name: Store UserID On Session
purpose: Binds the logged-in FileMaker account to a Karbon user: reads Get(AccountName), asks karbon_kontroller "Get User Object By AccountName" (375), then in the session record stores the user id, party id, account name and display name, and the user id in the meta record. Shows a "Profile Incomplete - contact a system admin" dialog when the user has no party id. Returns the result of the lookup.
writes:
session::CurrentUserId#58 (Set Field step 30, record found in step 29)
session::CurrentUserPartyId#63 (Set Field step 31, record found in step 29)
session::CurrentAccountName#60 (Set Field step 39, record found in step 29)
session::CurrentDisplayName#61 (Set Field step 40, record found in step 29)
meta#dataFile::CurrentUserId#3 (Set Field step 41, current record)
calls:
karbon_kontroller.fmp12/scripts/375 ("Get User Object By AccountName ( AccountName )", step 20)
karbon_kontacts.fmp12/scripts/43 ("Find Session Record", step 29)
open_question: Steps 10-13 (a check that bypasses admin/OAuth/valid account names, with an "exit app?" note) are disabled, so any account name is looked up. Step 29 calls "Find Session Record" (43) before the session fields are set. If the lookup returns an error nothing is stored and the script still returns to the original layout and exits with the error. Step 35 is only a dialog; the script continues with an empty party id.
